DOP: upanipajjati pr. 3 sg. [ S. upani√pad], lies down beside or near ( + acc.) ; D III 203, 13 (ṭhitaṃ vā upatiṭṭheyya nisinnaṃ vā upanisīdeyya nipannaṃ vā ~eyya); S III 151, 11 (tam eva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā ~ati); Vism 269, 13 (taṃ cittaṃ … tam ev’ ārammaṇaṃ … upanisīdati c’ eva ~ati ca); Ps II 407, 25 (nipannaṃ ~issasi); — aor. 3 sg. upanipajji, Ja V 231, 5 (naṃ aggamahesī ~i); — pp upanipanna , mfn. , lying down beside or near ; Vin III 189, 6 ; IV 69, 6 (bhikkhuniyā nisinnāya bhikkhu upanisinno vā hoti ~o vā).
CPD: upa-ni-pajjati , pr. 3 sg. [ sa. upanipadyate], to lie down at or near ( acc. ); — pp. upanipanna q. v.; — nipannaṃ vā ~eyya, D lll 203, 13 ; khīlam vā tham- bhaṃ vā ~ati, S lll 151, 11 ; upanisīdeyya vā ~eyya vā, A lV 128, 13 (= upagantvā nipajjeyya, Mp) quoted Vism 54, 30 ; atha naṃ aggamahesī ~i, Ja V 231, 5 ; Vism 269, 5 ; Sp 405, 30 .
NCP: pr. 3 sg. lies down beside or near (+acc.).
